type.headline: Multi-Sig wallet
type.caption: This is a special kind of wallet that needs multiple people to sign off on a transaction when you spend funds or withdraw rewards.

create.label: Create New Multi-Sig
create.caption: You can create a new multi-signature wallet from your existing wallets or by using external multi-sig keys.

join.label: Join a Multi-Sig
join.caption: You can join a multi-signature wallet by discovering it or by sharing your multi-sig public key with a friend from a wallet you've already added.

join.headline: Join a Multi-Sig
join.caption: Pick an option to show your Multi-Sig Key, Discover, or import an exported Multi-Sig wallet.

key.label: Multi-Sig Key
key.caption: Show the Multi-Sig key of your selected wallet to share with the person who's creating the Multi-Sig wallet.

discover.label: Discover
discover.caption: This scans the blockchain for registered Multi-Sig wallets that include your selected wallet's Multi-Sig key.

import.label: Import
import.caption: Load your created and exported Multi-Sig wallet JSON files here.

pubkey.headline: Wallet Multi-Sig Key
pubkey.caption: Share this with the Multi-Sig wallet creator.
pubkey.nopubkey: Looks like the Multi-Sig key for your selected wallet is missing.

discover.headline: Discovered Multi-Sig Wallets
discover.caption: Select the Multi-Sig wallets you've found to add them.

reused.toggle: Show Multi-Sig wallets with reused keys
reused.warning: Heads up: reused keys might be at risk for a replay attack, so use with caution!

discover.encrypted: Metadata is encrypted. Please decrypt it before adding, or no metadata will be imported!
discover.empty: We couldn't find any Multi-Sig wallets for your selected wallet.

data.nostake: This Multi-Sig wallet doesn't have any stake script registered.
data.nodrep: This Multi-Sig wallet doesn't have any DRep script registered.

import.headline: Import Multi-Sig Wallets
import.caption: Load your created and exported Multi-Sig wallet JSON files here.

error.invalid: This isn't a valid Multi-Sig export; it should follow the CSL AuxiliaryDataJSON format.
error.noscript: The imported file has no scripts.
error.nometa: The imported file has no label 1854 metadata.
error.duplicate: A Multi-Sig wallet with the same scripts has already been imported; ignoring the duplicate file.

create.headline: Multi-Sig Type
create.caption: Are all your participants equal, or are they part of groups/entities?

simple.label: Simple
simple.caption: A scenario where all participants are equal.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.caption: Participants are part of individual groups, forming multiple layers.

setup.headline: Multi-Sig Setup
setup.caption: Set a name and an optional description for your Multi-Sig wallet.

name.label: Wallet Name
name.placeholder: Please enter a name for the wallet.

participants.headline: Add Participants
participants.caption: Specify the individuals who should be part of the multi-sig from loaded wallets, or by inputting their multi-sig public key.

icon.label: Icon
icon.info: URL to user icon; non-animated image format, max 40KB & 64 characters. E.g., gravatar URL.

banner.headline: Disabled
banner.caption: Input is disabled when a Multi-Sig account public key is entered.

info.minimum: You need a minimum of two participants to form a simple multi-sig wallet.

error.duplicate: A participant with the same multi-sig key has already been added; please select another.

requiredSigners.headline: Required Signers
requiredSigners.caption: How many participants need to confirm when signing?

register.headline: Register
register.caption: Choose to either register or download the newly created Multi-Sig wallet.

register.label: Register
register.caption: Create a transaction to register the multi-signature wallet on-chain. This allows for automatic discovery by participants and is the recommended option.

download.label: Download
download.caption: Downloads a file to be shared with participants for manual import.

error.nofeewallet: No wallet found to use as the fee wallet for the Multi-Sig registration transaction.

register.exist: Wallet already exists, redirecting to wallet.

encrypt.headline: Encrypt your Metadata?
encrypt.caption: You can optionally set a password to encrypt your metadata.

flow.headline: Multi-Sig Authorization Chart
flow.caption: Pick the script type and use the interactive chart to build your custom Multi-Sig.

timelock.info: A time lock acts just like any participant, if the date set has passed, the time lock is treated as a valid entry in the required signers list of the parent node.
timelock.warning: A time lock in a far distant future might prevent you from spending funds until this date has passed, please verify that the intended date is set.

error.duplicateTimelock: A time lock has already been added for this node.

missing.headline: Create Multi-Sig Keys
missing.mnemonic: Your wallet is missing multi-sig keys. Please enter your wallet password to create them.
missing.hardware: Your wallet is missing multi-sig keys. Please click sign and follow your hardware device instructions to derive them.

save.ok: Multi-Sig keys successfully generated and saved to your wallet!
save.error: Couldn't save multi-sig keys to your wallet. Please try again!

popover.headline: Decrypt metadata
popover.caption: Enter your password to decrypt metadata.

error.noUnusedPaymentKeys: Couldn't find an unused payment key. Please re-sync your wallet!
error.noUnusedStakeKeys: Couldn't find an unused stake key. Please re-sync your wallet!
error.noUnusedDRepKeys: Couldn't find an unused DRep key. Please re-sync your wallet!
error.apiUsedKeyState: API error: We couldn't get the used key state.
error.unknownPubKeyError: Ran into an unknown error deriving keys from the Multi-Sig public key.
error.invalidPubKey: Invalid Multi-Sig public key. Please make sure the key is in bech32 format, according to CIP-5 (acct_shared_xvk).
error.scriptAddress: Script address detected. This isn't allowed in a Multi-Sig script.
